text.en:
Declaration of Policy - It is hereby declared policy of the
State that the defense and security of the Autonomous Region in Muslim
Mindanao (ARMM) shall be the responsibility of the national government.

ARMM Unified Command - There is hereby created and
organized an ARM Unified Command under the Southern Command, Armed
Forces of the Philippines, which shall be organized, maintained, and utilized in
accordance with national laws. Qualified inhabitants from the ARM shall be
given preference for assignment in the said unified command.

Command Relationship. - The ARM Unified Command
shall be under the direct supervision and control of the Commander, Southcom,
Pard Hologram # 20117

The Department of National Defense (DND) and the Armed Forces of the
Philippines shall determine the command relationship between Southern
Command, AFP, the ARMM Unified Command and AFP-wide support units of the
Major Services operating in Southern Philippines.

Calling Upon the Armed Forces - Notwithstanding, the
provisions of the preceding sections, the Regional Governor of the ARM may
request the President to call upon the Armed Forces of the Philippines:
(a) To prevent or suppress lawless violence, invasion, or rebellion, where
the public safety so requires, in the autonomous region in accordance
with the provisions of the Constitution;
(b) To suppress the danger to or breach of peace in the autonomous
region, where the Regional Police Force is not able to do so; or
(c) To avert any imminent danger to public order and security in the
autonomous region.
The President may on his/her own accord send the Armed Forces of the
Philippines to the autonomous region to attain the above-stated obiectives if the
Regional Governor does not act within fifteen (15) days after the occurrence of
the treats mentioned-above.

Regional Emergency. In times of regional emergency, all
elements of the Regional Police Force, the Regional Bureau of Fire Protection,
and the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology shall, upon direction of the
President or the Regional Governor, assist the Armed Forces of the Philippines in
meeting the emergency.
/

Implementing Rules. The DND, in coordination with the
Autonomous Regional Government particularly the ARM DILG, shall formulate
the rules and regulations implementing this Executive Order.
The Secretary of National Defense and all concerned AFP officials and
officers are hereby directed to extend their fullest assistance and cooperation to
the Autonomous Regional Government of the ARM to ensure the
implementation of this Order.

separability Clause. If, for any reason, any part or
provisions of this Executive Order shall be held unconstitutional or invalid, other
parts or provisions thereof, which are not affected thereby, shall continue to be
in full force and effect.
POMAHologram • 20118

Repealing Clause. All decrees, orders, rules and regulations
and other issuances or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive
Order are hereby repealed, modified or otherwise amended accordingly.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect fifteen (15)
days after its publication in a national newspaper of general circulation and in a
newspaper of local general circulation in the ARMM.
DONE in the City of Manila this
of our Lord, two thousand and three.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
